# News18
> News18 is an Indian digital news platform covering breaking news, politics, business, technology, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, and regional reporting.

News18 publishes national and international news alongside explainers, opinion, videos, photo galleries, and live coverage. Its network includes topic verticals, language editions, and special hubs for elections, cricket, and major developing stories.

## Main News Sections
- [India](https://www.news18.com/india/): National news coverage on politics, policy, crime, governance, and major developments across India.
- [World](https://www.news18.com/world/): International news, geopolitics, conflicts, diplomacy, and global affairs updates.
- [Politics](https://www.news18.com/politics/): Political news, party developments, campaigns, parliament, and leadership coverage.
- [Business](https://www.news18.com/business/): Business news, markets, economy, companies, personal finance, and policy reporting.
- [Tech](https://www.news18.com/tech/): Technology news, gadgets, apps, AI, telecom, and digital policy coverage.
- [Education-Career](https://www.news18.com/education-career/): Education news, exams, admissions, results, and career guidance updates.
- [Opinion](https://www.news18.com/opinion/): Commentary and analysis from columnists and contributors on current affairs.
- [Explainers](https://www.news18.com/explainers/): Backgrounders and explainers that break down complex news topics clearly.

## Entertainment & Lifestyle
- [Movies](https://www.news18.com/movies/): Film news, celebrity interviews, box office updates, and industry coverage.
- [Television](https://www.news18.com/television/): TV serial, reality show, celebrity, and broadcast entertainment news.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.news18.com/lifestyle/): Health, wellness, travel, relationships, food, and living features.
- [Buzz](https://www.news18.com/buzz/): Trending stories, internet culture, unusual news, and viral content.
- [Photos](https://www.news18.com/photogallery/): Photo galleries covering news events, entertainment, sports, and features.
- [Videos](https://www.news18.com/videos/): Video reports, interviews, explainers, and clips across major news categories.

## Sports Coverage
- [Cricket](https://www.news18.com/cricketnext/): Cricket news, live updates, match reports, rankings, and tournament coverage.
- [Sports](https://www.news18.com/sports/): Multi-sport coverage including football, tennis, badminton, and major events.
- [IPL](https://www.news18.com/cricketnext/ipl/): Indian Premier League news, fixtures, squads, and match analysis.
- [ICC Champions Trophy](https://www.news18.com/cricketnext/icc-champions-trophy/): Tournament-focused cricket coverage, schedules, and match stories.
- [Live Cricket Score](https://www.news18.com/cricketnext/live-score/): Live cricket scores, scorecards, and match tracking pages.
- [Cricket Photos](https://www.news18.com/cricketnext/photogallery/): Cricket image galleries from matches, players, and tournaments.

## Elections & Politics Hubs
- [Elections](https://www.news18.com/elections/): Central elections hub with state polls, results, analysis, and political updates.
- [Lok Sabha Elections](https://www.news18.com/elections/lok-sabha-election/): General election coverage including phases, candidates, and constituency updates.
- [Assembly Elections](https://www.news18.com/elections/assembly-election/): State assembly election news, schedules, campaigns, and results.
- [Election Results](https://www.news18.com/elections/results/): Results hub with counting trends, winners, and seat tallies.
- [Exit Polls](https://www.news18.com/elections/exit-polls/): Exit poll projections, methodology notes, and state-wise estimates.
- [Politics News](https://www.news18.com/politics/): Ongoing political reporting beyond election cycles and campaign periods.

## Utility & Live Coverage
- [Live TV](https://www.news18.com/livetv/): Live streaming access to News18 television news channels.
- [Live Blog](https://www.news18.com/live-blog/): Rolling live blogs for breaking news, elections, sports, and major events.
- [Latest News](https://www.news18.com/latest/): Reverse-chronological feed of the newest published stories across sections.
- [Trending](https://www.news18.com/trending/): Popular and currently trending stories across the News18 network.
- [Web Stories](https://www.news18.com/web-stories/): Short visual story format for quick updates and lifestyle content.
- [Newsletters](https://www.news18.com/newsletters/): Newsletter signup and editorial digest offerings.

## Regional & Language Network
- [News18 Hindi](https://hindi.news18.com/): Hindi-language edition covering national, regional, and local news.
- [News18 বাংলা](https://bengali.news18.com/): Bengali-language news coverage for West Bengal and beyond.
- [News18 தமிழ்](https://tamil.news18.com/): Tamil-language edition with state, national, and entertainment reporting.
- [News18 తెలుగు](https://telugu.news18.com/): Telugu-language news for Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and national topics.
- [News18 മലയാളം](https://malayalam.news18.com/): Malayalam-language coverage of Kerala, India, and world news.
- [News18 ಕನ್ನಡ](https://kannada.news18.com/): Kannada-language reporting focused on Karnataka and national developments.
- [News18 ગુજરાતી](https://gujarati.news18.com/): Gujarati-language news, politics, business, and regional updates.
- [News18 ਪੰਜਾਬੀ](https://punjab.news18.com/): Punjabi-language edition covering Punjab and broader current affairs.

## Network & Brand Pages
- [CNN-News18](https://www.news18.com/cnn-news18/): Coverage and updates related to the CNN-News18 television news brand.
- [CNBC-TV18](https://www.news18.com/cnbc-tv18/): Business television brand content and market-focused reporting.
- [News18 India](https://www.news18.com/news18-india/): Hindi television news brand page and related coverage.
- [For the Record](https://www.news18.com/for-the-record/): Corrections, clarifications, and editorial accountability updates.
- [About Us](https://www.news18.com/about-us/): Corporate and editorial information about the News18 platform.
- [Contact Us](https://www.news18.com/contact-us/): Contact information and communication channels for the organization.

## Special Coverage & Features
- [Health](https://www.news18.com/health/): Health reporting, medical explainers, wellness advice, and public health news.
- [Science](https://www.news18.com/science/): Science discoveries, space, environment, and research-related reporting.
- [Auto](https://www.news18.com/auto/): Automobile news, launches, reviews, and mobility industry coverage.
- [Travel](https://www.news18.com/travel/): Travel news, destination features, tips, and tourism updates.
- [Food](https://www.news18.com/food/): Recipes, food trends, restaurant stories, and culinary features.
- [Astrology](https://www.news18.com/astrology/): Horoscope, astrology features, and festival-related spiritual content.
